yieldVsArea.title: Yield vs area
yieldVsArea.formula: Yield = median new-lease rent/㎡ ÷ median sale price/㎡
yieldVsArea.methodology: Effective yield = area median rent/㎡ ÷ this project's listed median price/㎡ — what you'd earn buying at the price you actually pay and renting at area rates. The gap vs area is driven by price positioning: the higher the listed premium, the lower the effective yield at the same rent. An estimate (no rental history at the new price); real rents outperforming the area would raise it. DLD periodic snapshot; registrations lag 4–8 weeks.
yieldVsArea.priceUpDetail: Listed below the area median — lifts effective yield
yieldVsArea.priceDownDetail: Listed above the area median — dilutes effective yield
yieldVsArea.rentFlatDetail: No settled rentals yet — rent assumed at area level; real outperformance lifts it
yieldVsArea.rentUpDetail: Higher new-lease rent/㎡ — smaller units, newer or fitted
yieldVsArea.rentDownDetail: Lower new-lease rent/㎡ — larger units or older stock
yieldVsArea.offplanDetail: No settled rent yet — estimated at area ready-home basis

priceCheck.title: Price check
priceCheck.noData: Not enough area sales to run a price check.
priceCheck.noDataHint: Based on DLD sales snapshots; unavailable for new communities or thin samples.
priceCheck.methodology: Area baseline = the area's last-12-month DLD residential (Unit/Villa) price/m² distribution, top/bottom 5% trimmed, median taken. Project price = median of unit-type prices in AED/m². DLD periodic snapshot (not live); resale registrations lag 4–8 weeks.
priceCheck.eAbove: About {{p}}% above the area's median over the last {{months}} months. A premium for new-build over resale is common — weigh it against payment plan, handover timing and floor/view.
priceCheck.eBelow: About {{p}}% below the area's median over the last {{months}} months — may reflect unit mix, building age or specific units.
priceCheck.eInline: In line with the area's recent median.
priceCheck.eNoPrice: No usable unit price on file — showing the area's range for reference only.
priceCheck.eInsufficient: Not enough comparable area sales for a price call — indicative only.

nearby.title: Nearby projects compared
nearby.footer: Yield / growth / premium reflect each project's matched development or area (new launches are usually area-level). "From" is the lowest listed unit price. DLD periodic snapshot — for side-by-side reference only.

deals.title: Recent real deals
deals.footer: Recent registered DLD deals for this development — cross-check against the listed price and area median above.

tab.subtitle: This project vs its area, backed by real deals and nearby projects, to judge whether it stacks up.
tab.guideIntro: A few lenses to consider — your own judgment matters too:
tab.p1d: Close means rent efficiency matches the area; a big gap is worth digging into. New launches with a high premium usually earn a lower effective yield — whether that's worth it depends on cash-flow vs future growth.
tab.p2d: New builds priced above area resale is normal. The question isn't "expensive?" but whether the premium is repaid by location, handover, finish or future growth.
tab.p3d: The listed price is the ask; registered deals are what the market pays. A wide gap flags negotiation room or premium froth.
tab.p4d: Same area, same price band, side by side — more reliable than one number in isolation.
